name: Extra vocal, Playback to Aux 8

inferred.basis: mix bus sends are post fader per the conventions
FX bus send is post fader, as stated for Vox Verb

provenance.channel: Change: add another vocal channel; named Vox 2 by me, as the change gives no name
provenance.patch: No socket named in the change; A 16 is free on the desk, chosen by me
provenance.processing: Conventions: vocals get the 'Vocal' preset, gain 20 dB, trim 0 dB; HPF comes from the preset
provenance.fader: Conventions: every channel fader fully down, unmuted
provenance.bus_sends: Conventions: every vocals channel goes to Vocals POST at 0 dB and Vox Verb POST at -6 dB; the instructions list no monitor sends for it
provenance.main_routes: Conventions: a channel in a mix bus does not also go to Main directly

inferred.basis: a single new vocal mic, one input, so mono
monitor sends are pre fader per the conventions

provenance.channel: Change: move Playback to Aux 8, so the channel is rebuilt as aux strip 8
provenance.patch: Same sockets as the existing Playback channel, LCL 1+2
provenance.fader: Conventions: every fader fully down, unmuted
provenance.bus_sends: Instructions: Playback sends to Drum IEM; PRE at -18 dB
provenance.main_routes: Playback goes straight to Main 1, as the existing channel did

inferred.basis: the existing Playback is a stereo pair on LCL 1+2, which I kept

notes: 'Move Playback to Aux 8' read as aux strip 8, since the instructions use 'Aux 1' for a strip. Playback is dropped from the channel bank and rebuilt as aux 8 on the same LCL 1+2 sockets, with its DCA, Drum IEM send and Main route unchanged. If you meant the Aux In 1/4" socket instead, a stereo pair there would be AUX 7+8.
The new vocal channel has no name or socket in the change. I called it 'Vox 2' and chose A 16, both marked as my choices. Rename it or give a socket if different.
The new vocal has no monitor sends, because the instructions list none for it.
An aux strip has no high-pass filter, which suits a line-level playback feed.
